title: NeoRadar controlled airspace dataset
description: datasets/cas.geojson: the controlled airspace the airspace infringement net (safetyNets.aiw) watches, one Polygon per volume with its class and vertical limits. Written by `neoradar-cli convert` from the sector file's [ARTCC HIGH] and [ARTCC LOW] outlines and the limits in the sector source's data/cas.json (`@schemas/data/cas.schema.json`); never hand-edited. Coordinates are EPSG:3857 metres like every other GeoJSON in datasets/. A volume is inside strictly: an aircraft exactly at a limit is not in it. An FT limit is judged on the QNH altitude, an FL limit on the pressure altitude. Absent file: the net watches the zones tagged safetyNets.aiw.controlledZoneTag, else the online sectors' volumes. With the file, the zones tagged controlled still win, because the package drew them on purpose.

name.description: Free text; the converter names the sector file it came from.

items.description: A closed ring. The first is the outline of the face the sector file's lines enclose; each after it is a hole, where a separate group of the same name's lines sits inside the face.

name.description: The volume as the AIP names it; what the alert text prints.

airspace.description: The sector file group the outline came from.
